name: VMRF (View Matching Neural Radiance Fields)
definition: A method for novel view synthesis that learns NeRF representations without prior knowledge of camera poses or hand-crafted camera pose distributions. It uses a view matching scheme to produce a feature transport plan mapping a rendered image (with random pose) to a real image, and a pose calibration technique to rectify randomized poses by predicting relative pose transformations.
summary: VMRF is a novel view synthesis method that learns NeRF representations without camera poses by estimating relative pose transformations via unbalanced optimal transport, solving pose estimation failures in texture-poor scenes.
